name: Services Rows
description: A dark services block: a split header over numbered service rows, each with a white curtain that wipes on hover flipping the text dark, a photo that pops upright and a go tile that flips light; plus a two-tone sub-heading and three support cards that expand on hover with a rolling label.
interactions: pure-CSS hover choreography: a white curtain wipes left-to-right (scaleX) flipping row text dark, the photo pops from rotate/scale to upright, the go tile flips light; support cards flex-grow on hover and their label rolls; prefers-reduced-motion turns transitions off
